api.description: Express.js APIs with action-based routing pattern
audited: Action-based routing (1 file = 1 action) on 6 APIs
api.why: Perfect score: All 6 APIs (EZAuth, EZPay, EZBill, Tower Defense, GreenPulse, EZStart) migrated to action-based pattern with 217+ action files. Complete OpenAPI docs, standardized CORS, comprehensive error handling.

databases.description: MongoDB architecture with factory functions and connection pooling
audited: Factory function pattern (getUserModel) across all APIs
databases.why: Perfect score: Fully migrated to factory function pattern, centralized mongo connection, triple protection for tests (NODE_ENV check, localhost fallback, .env.test support). Zero deprecated patterns.

notAudited: Strict rate limiting on auth endpoints (currently 100/15min global)
security.why: Good coverage with JWT + HttpOnly cookies, environment isolation. Missing: automated secrets rotation (manual process), stricter rate limits on sensitive endpoints (login/register should be 5/min not 100/15min), security headers not standardized.
nextSteps: Implement strict rate limiting (5 req/min) on /login, /register, /reset-password
Add helmet.js middleware to all APIs
Document secrets rotation policy (90-day cycle)
Add 2FA support to EZAuth (Google Authenticator)

notAudited: Skeleton loaders on all data fetching
ux.why: Excellent with Design System + WelcomeModal + Progress bars. Missing: skeleton loaders not universal (only some components), empty states inconsistent (some apps have nice illustrations, others just text), toast notifications use different libraries (sonner vs react-hot-toast).

Create EmptyState component in @ezstart/ui
Standardize toast notifications (pick one: sonner)
